formulaSource: Self-imposed measurement contracts; organizer did not publish complete scoring formulas

metrics.measurement: Correct task-relevant controls/structure divided by annotated controls/structure; report precision and recall separately.
metrics.diagnostic_note: Raster-only slice: no exported controls and no original visual pixels retained. Dataset has no interactive-control ground truth; full utility accuracy remains unmeasured.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: Wave2 held-out synthetic fixtures report mean visual precision 1.0 / recall ~0.78 (fixture-only). Extension collect on real fixture exports 3 allow-listed controls. Not interactive held-out page saturation.

metrics.measurement: Instance precision TP/(TP+FP) and recall TP/(TP+FN), by email/name/number/password/face; frozen IoU and matching rules.
metrics.diagnostic_note: 100 external synthetic raster screens / 810 selected PII regions: zero UltraFace predictions. Cross-taxonomy localization recall 0, precision undefined; not general PII classifier or face accuracy.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: Wave2 held-out fixtures mean instance recall ~0.67 / precision 0.8 including intentional detector-miss case. UltraFace still face-only; external WebPII raster recall unchanged. Not a saturated PII classifier.

metrics.measurement: PII pixel coverage and non-PII preservation reported separately; conservative reconstruction must count useful removed pixels as utility loss.
metrics.diagnostic_note: Full-image exclusion covers all selected PII pixels while preserving zero pixels outside those boxes. This is not selective-redaction success.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: Wave2 selective scores separate mean piiPixelCoverage ~0.83 vs nonPiiPreservation ~0.82 on held-out synthetics; full-image over-redaction and miss cases retained. Local preview only; egress semantics-only.

metrics.measurement: Cold/warm WASM load, inference p50/p95, downloaded bytes, JS/WASM memory where measurable, CPU/long tasks on recorded device.
metrics.diagnostic_note: 100 inferences after 10 warmups measured on main thread and worker. Includes detector time, JS heap and long tasks; no total process memory, CPU utilization or energy measurement.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: Wave2 adds shared client-resources hooks and extension capture-stage JS heap/timing when performance.memory exists. observed still null; no process RSS/CPU/energy claim. See wave2-client-resources-v01.json.

metrics.measurement: User trigger to verified correct end-state, including capture, model, network and action; report human review separately without omitting it from full time.
metrics.diagnostic_note: Provider pilot and continuous task recording exist, but no 100-attempt full-flow latency distribution. Under-200ms gate remains failed.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: Under-200ms full-flow gate remains fail. Overlay captureVisibleTab ~38ms is capture-only, not full-flow. Do not weaken.

scoreReason: No authoritative normalization. Wave2 adds held-out synthetic fixtures + Chromium capture harness diagnostics only. Do not estimate judge probability.
